qa.question: Should the brief's mention of NRG as owner be dropped for Riverside?
qa.finding: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists Riverside Generating Co LLC as the entity. Web results point to LS Power Development as parent, and a Kentucky Public Service Commission brief says LS Power bought it from Dynegy. I found no document naming NRG.
qa.recommendation: Leave the owner as Riverside Generating Co LLC [100%]. No sale or retirement was found.
qa.note: I could not open a document that states the current parent directly. Gridinfo did not show the text LS Power in the verifier run. NRG filings were not searched beyond one web search that returned nothing naming NRG. In pass two I searched the SEC full-text index for Catlettsburg in 10-K filings from 2025 on and found no NRG filing naming Riverside.

qa.question: Do the PJM Riverside uprate requests W3-162 and Y2-045 change any unit capacity?
qa.finding: The PJM queue file at https://www.pjm.com/pub/planning/downloads/xml/PlanningQueues.xml lists request W3-162 for 20 MW, in service September 2011, and Y2-045 for 6 MW, in service January 2016. Both name Riverside Generating at Baker 345 kV and show a facility output of 993 and 999 MW. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 still lists 230 MW for each of the five units.
qa.recommendation: Leave unit capacity at 230 MW. Ask the project manager whether the 26 MW of added output should be recorded.
qa.note: The queue file does not say which turbine each uprate belongs to. Requests W1-035 (750 MW, withdrawn) and X2-006 (no capacity) are earlier Riverside expansion requests that never entered service.

qa.question: Are the new PJM requests C01-1131 and C01-1325 at Baker 345 kV new gas units at Riverside?
qa.finding: PJM's 2026 cycle file lists C01-1131 for 458 MW from Kentucky Power Company, requested in service September 2030, and C01-1325 for 1,046 MW from Appalachian Power Company, requested September 2031. Both are gas, in Lawrence County, at the same 345 kV substation Riverside uses, and neither names Riverside. C01-1325 belongs to Appalachian Power, not Kentucky Power, and fits the gas need in Appalachian Power's 2025 resource plan; it is answered on its own card.
qa.recommendation: Do not add a unit at Riverside. Ask the project manager whether C01-1131 is the Kentucky Power gas plant in its integrated resource plan, and add it as a separate plant if so.
qa.note: The cycle file is at https://www.pjm.com/planning/m/cycle-service-request-status. Developer names are from that file; no owner site or air permit application naming a Riverside expansion was found. The Division for Air Quality shows only a pending permit change from October 2026 with no documents online.
